distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Anisandrus lineatus from Sichuan. Smith et al. (2022) adds Yunnan, including locality evidence from Honghe.

host_note: Machilus, Symplocos and Alnus are retained as genus-level host records from Smith et al. (2020).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus lineatus (Eggers, 1930).
